app.description: Your self-hosted board-game shelf and game-night picker.

auth.signUpDescription: Enter your details to get started.
auth.forgotDescription: Enter your email. If an account exists, we’ll send a secure reset link.
auth.bootstrapDescription: Set up the first account. It will have full administrator access.
auth.name: Name
auth.passwordHelp: Use 12–128 characters. A unique password from a password manager is best.
auth.resetSentBody: If an account exists for that address, a single-use reset link is on its way. It expires in 60 minutes.
auth.verificationBody: We sent a verification link to your email address. Open it to activate your account.
auth.verificationResent: If the address is eligible, another verification email is on its way.
auth.banned: This account has been suspended. Contact an administrator.
auth.signUpDisabled: Registration is closed on this instance.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: Choose a strong new password. Updating it signs you out everywhere else.
reset.done: Password updated. You can sign in now.
reset.invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask an administrator for a new one.
reset.expired: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask an administrator for a new one.
reset.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again later.

dashboard.title: What are we playing tonight, {name}?
dashboard.summary: {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} in your collection, {unplayed, plural, =0 {and every one has been played.} other {# still waiting for a first play.}}
dashboard.emptyBody: Add a game by name, or import the CSV export of your BoardGameGeek collection.
dashboard.noWeights: Complexity ratings show up here once your games have them.
dashboard.allPlayed: Every base game in your collection has been played.
dashboard.wishlistCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing saved for later yet.} one {# game saved for later.} other {# games saved for later.}}

collection.title: Your collection
collection.emptyBody: Use “Add a game” above to start building your collection.
collection.otherExpansionsBody: Their matching base game is not currently on this shelf.
collection.count: {count, plural, one {# game, ready for the table.} other {# games, ready for the table.}}

libraryFilters.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, category, mechanic, or theme…

libraryPagination.loadError: These games could not be loaded.

game.removeBody: This removes the game and its personal rating, notes, favorite, played status, and purchase price from your collection.
game.giftedHelp: Gifted games count as having a recorded price, without adding to your spending total.
game.moreActionsHint: Edit, open on BoardGameGeek, or remove

add.selectedBody: Add the details Board Games Tracker needs for your shelf and picker.
add.searchBodyWithUrl: Type a title or paste a BoardGameGeek game URL. Search starts automatically after three characters.
add.descriptionPlaceholder: A short description for your local catalog
add.metadataUnavailable: BoardGameGeek details could not be loaded, so the values below are generic placeholders. Please check them before saving.

search.tooMany: Too many searches. Try again in a minute.
search.terms: Enter at least three characters or a BGG game URL.

import.title: Import from BoardGameGeek
import.body: Export your collection as CSV on BGG, then upload it here. Owned games, played status, ratings, notes, categories, mechanics, and cover art are imported.
import.limit: Maximum 5 MB and 2,000 rows. Existing matches are updated; games not marked as owned are ignored.

play.title: Choose a game
play.description: Set the table, narrow the shelf, and give the wheel a spin.

picker.emptyBody: Add a game to your collection first, then come back for the big decision.
picker.possibleGames: {count, plural, one {# possible game} other {# possible games}}
picker.possibleGamesDescription: {count, plural, =0 {No games match the current filters.} one {Choose the matching game directly.} other {Browse all # games matching your filters.}}
picker.noFit: No game fits. Relax one of the filters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account, currency, imports, exports, and local data.
settings.session: Sessions are stored server-side, rotate automatically, and expire after 14 days. Use Sign out in the sidebar to revoke this session.
settings.currencyBody: Used for purchase prices and collection totals.
settings.credentialsBody: Update your sign-in email or password. Password changes sign out your other sessions.
settings.emailBody: Change the address you use to sign in.
settings.passwordBody: Use at least 12 characters. Your other sessions will be signed out.
settings.emailConfirmationSent: Check your current inbox to confirm the email-address change.
settings.emailFailed: The email address could not be updated.
settings.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Other sessions were signed out.
settings.passwordFailed: The password could not be updated. Check your current password.
settings.deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your account, sessions, library, and personal data. Enter your current password to continue.
settings.deleteAccountSummary: Permanently remove your account and all of its data.
settings.deleteConfirmationSent: Check your inbox to confirm permanent account deletion.
settings.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted. Check your password and try again.
settings.aboutBody: Where this application is developed, and who maintains it.

sharing.title: Share your library
sharing.body: Publish your collection or wishlist as a private link. Anyone with the link can view it, no account needed. Nothing is shared until you turn it on.
sharing.sharePricesHelp: Show what you paid and which games were gifts. Off by default.
sharing.copyFailed: The link could not be copied
sharing.shareWishlistHelp: Publish the games you are hoping for.
sharing.linkWarning: Treat this link like a password: anyone who has it can view what you share. Regenerate it to revoke every link you have handed out.
sharing.regenerated: New link generated. The previous link no longer works.
sharing.publicBody: A library shared by its owner. Read-only.
sharing.updateFailed: Sharing settings could not be saved. Please try again.

wishlist.title: Your wishlist
wishlist.emptyBody: Save games you are considering, then move them into your collection when you buy them.
wishlist.purchaseBody: The game will leave your wishlist and become part of your owned collection.
wishlist.removeBody: This only removes the saved wishlist item.
wishlist.count: {count, plural, one {# game you may want to buy.} other {# games you may want to buy.}}
wishlist.purchaseHint: Move this game into your collection
wishlist.removeHint: Remove this game from the wishlist

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: See where your budget went and what kinds of games define your shelf.
stats.easiestHint: The lightest rated base games, by BGG weight.
stats.hardestHint: The heaviest rated base games, by BGG weight.
stats.noData: Add more collection details to unlock this chart.
stats.playersHint: A game counts for every table size it supports.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Export a backup or merge a previous Board Games Tracker export.
data.exportBody: Includes your collection, wishlist, played status, prices, notes, ratings, preferences, and game metadata. Passwords and sessions are never exported.
data.importBody: Upload a JSON, CSV, XLSX, or SQL export created here. Games missing from the shared catalog are added and existing entries are left unchanged.
data.invalid: This is not a valid Board Games Tracker data export.
data.serverError: The import could not be completed. Please try again.
data.tooLarge: The import must be no larger than 10 MB.
data.tooMany: Too many data transfers. Try again in ten minutes.
data.unsupported: Choose a JSON, CSV, XLSX, or SQL file.
data.bggBody: Use an official BGG collection CSV as a one-way source.

clear.title: Clear collection
clear.body: Remove every owned game, rating, favorite, played status, note, and purchase price from your collection. Your wishlist, account, and other users are not affected.
clear.warning: This cannot be undone. Type {confirmation} below to confirm. Shared game information and cached covers remain available to other users.
clear.wishlistBody: Permanently remove every game from your wishlist. Your collection is left untouched. This cannot be undone.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Manage access, review system activity, and monitor the application.
admin.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the account, active sessions, collection entries, and personal data. This cannot be undone.
admin.loadError: The audit events could not be loaded.
admin.resetFailed: The reset link could not be created
admin.resetCopied: Reset link copied. It expires in one hour and works once.
admin.resetPasswordHint: Copy a password reset link for this account
admin.deleteHint: Delete this account and everything in it

adminGames.title: Board-game metadata
adminGames.body: Every game stored on this instance. Metadata is shared, so a correction here applies to every collection that includes the game.
adminGames.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or BGG id
adminGames.loadError: The games could not be loaded.
adminGames.name: Name
adminGames.owners: {count, plural, =0 {in no collections} one {in # collection} other {in # collections}}
adminGames.refreshHelp: Pull the current metadata and expansion relationships from BoardGameGeek and overwrite this record. Useful when a game was added while BoardGameGeek was unreachable.
adminGames.refreshFailed: BoardGameGeek did not return data for this game. Try again shortly.
adminGames.editHint: Correct this entry in the shared catalog

error.title: Something knocked over the board.
error.body: No private details were shown. Try this view again; an administrator can inspect the structured server logs if it continues.

notFound.title: This tile isn’t on the board.
notFound.body: The page may have moved, or someone packed it into the wrong box.

action.invalidCsv: The file is not a supported BoardGameGeek collection export.
action.noOwned: No owned games were found in this export.
action.importRateLimited: Too many collection imports. Try again in ten minutes.
action.imported: Imported {games} owned games with {artwork} database-cached covers.
action.chooseGame: Choose the game again before adding it.
action.addRateLimited: Too many games were added. Try again in a minute.
action.alreadyOwned: This game is already in your collection.
action.movedToCollection: The game is now in your collection.
action.confirmClear: Type {confirmation} to confirm clearing your collection.

mail.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
mail.footer: This email was sent automatically by Board Games Tracker.

verification.subject: Verify your email address
verification.preview: Complete your Board Games Tracker account verification.
verification.heading: Verify your email address
verification.body: Confirm that this email address belongs to you to finish setting up your account.
verification.safety: If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email. The link expires in 60 minutes.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.preview: Use this secure link to reset your password.
passwordReset.heading: Choose a new password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account.
passwordReset.safety: If you did not request a reset, ignore this email. The link expires in 60 minutes and can be used only once.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your email-address change
emailChange.preview: Authorize the email-address change for your account.
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.body: A request was made to replace your email address with {email}. Confirm the change from your current address.
emailChange.safety: If you did not request this change, do not use the link and change your password. The link expires in 60 minutes.

accountDeletion.subject: Confirm account deletion
accountDeletion.heading: Confirm account deletion
accountDeletion.body: A request was made to permanently delete your account and its associated data.
accountDeletion.safety: Do not use the link if you did not request deletion. The link expires in 24 hours.
